_comment: Relative probability weight per 24 hour-of-day bucket for a birth event. Based on aggregate CDC/WHO natal hour statistics: daytime peak 8am-4pm (scheduled sections + inductions), quiet overnight (1-5am). Weights do not sum to 24 — the sampler normalizes at use.
_month_weights_comment: Monthly birth bias — Northern hemisphere shows slight August-October peak. Keep flat for Phase 2; add seasonality in Phase 3 if needed.
